assertions: Registration submits through custom validation even when fields are invalid, so browser-native suppression cannot hide the error.
Password mismatch shows 两次输入的密码不一致.
A registration password shorter than 8 characters shows 密码长度必须在 8-128 个字符之间.
A blank invite code shows 请输入注册邀请码 in the browser and 注册邀请码长度必须在 4-128 个字符之间 at the API boundary.
Auth API validation, registration, login, and rate-limit messages are readable Chinese rather than mojibake.
red_test: Issue #3 cases: mismatched passwords, password shorter than 8, and blank invite code.
green_test: npm run test:access -> 7 passed, 0 failed; git diff --check passed.
same_case_requirement: The three reported registration cases remain visible as actionable error text without a network request for client-invalid input.
